overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice for and convene a meeting during the July 15, 2013 Select Board meeting, where a quorum deliberated; the Select Board's later remedial steps were deemed appropriate.

allegations.summary: A quorum of the Board of Assessors allegedly deliberated during the July 15, 2013 Select Board meeting, though no Board meeting was posted or convened.
allegations.key_passage: That quorum's communication on public business within its jurisdiction constituted a deliberation, which may only occur during a properly posted meeting.

allegations.summary: The Board argued the Select Board alone appoints town officers, so the discussion was not a Board deliberation; the AG rejected this defense.
allegations.key_passage: The position of assistant assessor is a matter within the Board's jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: The complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting before the July 15, 2013 Select Board meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the July 15, 2013 meeting of the Select Board included deliberation by a quorum of the Board of Assessors on a matter within its jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: The Board allegedly failed to take minutes of the July 15, 2013 meeting at which a quorum deliberated.
allegations.key_passage: and take minutes of its meeting during the July 15, 2013 Select Board meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and its accompanying regulations, 940 CMR 29.00.
Create and approve accurate minutes from the July 15, 2013 meeting; the Board may review and adopt the minutes already taken by the Select Board.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18­25, and its accompanying regulations, 940 CMR 29.00.  We additionally order the Board to create and approve accurate minutes from the July 15, 2013 meeting.
